verdict.rationale: Snowflake supports bulk operations at scale via SQL (bulk UPDATE/DELETE/COPY INTO), Snowpipe micro-batch loading, streams for change capture, CLI and REST/SQL APIs for programmatic/scripted execution, and resizable warehouses to scale compute for large batch jobs — all usable by an AI-native/scripted user (e.g., headless `snow sql` piping shown in probe evidence). missing for 10: no explicit documentation or hands-on evidence of an AI agent issuing bulk operations across many items in one call (e.g., batch APIs for bulk row-level agent actions) or benchmarks/community validation of bulk-op performance/reliability at scale.
